description: Use this when the person asks to see their progress on a graph. Draws one of their Progress graphs from their records: lift_max or lift_volume per session for one exercise (key), weekly_volume, body_weight (90 days), cardio_distance, cardio_pace or cardio_heart_rate, daily_kcal or daily_protein (30 days). Training volume is the number that matters most. Do not use for sleep or heart-rate numbers, which stay in the Almost Fire app.

key.description: The exercise key for lift_max, lift_volume and the cardio graphs; null otherwise.

note.description: One line on what the graph shows, in your words.

name: show_progress_chart
title: Show a progress graph
